tbesh_html:
1) pool, troubled pool
1a) troubled or muddy (gloomy) pools, marshes
1b) any pool, pond
1c) swamp reeds, reeds, rush(es)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water);
